note: Raise upward correction cap to 3x for accepted corrections where base level is large relative to sigma; strong local events exceed seed 50 percent cap.
Allow up to 4x base on accepted 5x or stronger high-level localized events; retain 3x cap for other high-level increases.
Calibrate accepted 3x events to a 2.5x cap on high-level series; full 3x overshoots the moderate events in the visible traces.
Use extracted 4x-5x event magnitude on high-level series instead of stopping at 3x-4x; preserve seed validator and low-level guard.
Apply short zero-multiplier shutdowns fully; visible short shutdown windows reach near-zero truth while full-horizon zero remains capped.
Ignore downward percentage corrections where the base value is below the series calibration scale; these changes have negligible raw effect and distort near-zero forecasts.
For short zero-multiplier events, use full shutdown inside the window and taper the final boundary step to the existing half-strength forecast.
For a zero target spanning the horizon of a steadily declining positive series, taper the base forecast smoothly toward zero; retain abrupt shutdown handling for short windows.
Accept short documented increases of 30–100 percent on stable high-level series even when the fixed validator rejects them; their small magnitude is a weak acceptance signal.
Suppress per-step nonzero corrections whose full implied change is under five sigma_main_calib; multiplier changes within the local calibration scale are unreliable.
Bound extreme event multipliers in calibration-scale absolute units when the local baseline is near zero and avoid already elevated steps.
Allow half-strength modest local uplifts with a large absolute implied effect when cell backtests show Toto is unreliable.
